The clinic is very beautiful, in a European style.
The doctor gave excellent advice.
The doctor was very kind and gave excellent advice.
Dr. Thawisak did a great job on my implant and for another crown replacement he worked diligently to save the tooth, flexible and caring, he's become a friend actually.

The dentist is kind and does excellent dental work. The staff are polite and provide excellent service. The clinic is clean and safe, but please call to make an appointment.
I will definitely be back.

I was in the area on business and needed a teeth cleaning, so I called to inquire about the price on September 13, 2019 at 1:19 PM. I also wanted to know what services were available. A woman, who sounded older, answered the phone.
She spoke very rudely and impolitely, saying, “Are you calling to survey the price? I won't tell you, and no clinic will tell you the price. You have to come in yourself.” Then she hung up. I called 2-3 other clinics in the area, and they willingly answered my questions about prices and available times.

I don't know what kind of training this woman was given to answering the phone and speaking so rudely.

I wanted to see a dentist. I rang in and had a very rude woman answer my phone regarding the price inquiry! Sooooo rude, unbelievable how rude she is!
Wonderful service by Dr. Thaweesak - helped me to redo bridge and implant issues. Better treatment than I received back at home. Highly recommended.

I had to get my stiches removed from my gums as i was in thailand, the staff was so nice and let me sit down even i was hours late. The dentist was super caring, very professional and disnt even charge me! Recommend it to everyone!
